propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB; 92% is the reconciler's .bridge_state cache due to scattered bookkeeping edits (baseline_advanced_at changed 1144 times per pass, never read in src/) that defeat git delta compression, adding 12.79 KB marginal cost per version.

Deleting baseline_advanced_at timestamp reduces marginal pack cost by 7.4x to 1.74 KB; moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json halves version count for total 12.8x reduction.

The .bridge_state cache must remain committed on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners and durable state must live in git; re-homing off-branch was previously evaluated and dropped because the convergence loop already self-heals binding drift.

A git fast-export/filter/fast-import pipeline on the real branch compresses history from 1,172,586,762 to 98,803,422 bytes (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges; dynamic re-add restores current files so rewritten HEAD tree is byte-identical to pre-rewrite tip.

A2-2 mixed-version rollout gate requires descendant reconcile workflow execution with explicit host refresh, and A6-1 reclaim gate requires descendant workflow execution, live review-bot and host-runtime epoch refusal probes, deployment receipts, a verified off-repo backup bundle, and quiesced publication window before execution.
